changes: Create an empty exclusive secrets directory with a verified private Windows DACL before any key storage. Existing wide/reparse directories and identities are refused without ACL repair or silent key rotation.

Open a unique wx empty temporary file, protect it before writing key bytes, validate existing target again before atomic replacement, and close/remove only an owned temporary file on failure. A collision is not deleted.

Managed environment overrides bypass unused local identity reads in both enrollment status and connector configuration.

POSIX directory/file modes remain 0700/0600. Four original multi-round identity cases use a Windows-only 40s test budget for real ACL subprocess costs; production timeouts and POSIX test budgets are unchanged.
